REMINDER_FATIGUE.title: Reminder Notification Fatigue
REMINDER_FATIGUE.description: Patients overwhelmed by daily push notifications stopped responding after day 10-14.
REMINDER_FATIGUE.mitigation: Adaptive notification throttling, automatic cooldown periods, and quiet-hour enforcement.

CAREGIVER_DEPENDENCY.title: Caregiver Hand-off Delay
CAREGIVER_DEPENDENCY.description: Elderly patients reliant on family members missed reporting on days caregivers were unavailable.
CAREGIVER_DEPENDENCY.mitigation: Dual-access caregiver portal view, simplified 1-tap logging, and SMS check-in support.

EDUCATION_FRICTION.title: Education Resistance / Reading Fatigue
EDUCATION_FRICTION.description: Patients with high daily check-in adherence avoided lengthy text educational modules.
EDUCATION_FRICTION.mitigation: Micro-learning cards with 3 bullet points max and 2-question visual comprehension checks.

POST_OP_PAIN_DROPOFF.title: Drop-off After Initial Recovery Comfort
POST_OP_PAIN_DROPOFF.description: Patients feeling better around week 3 assumed monitoring was no longer required.
POST_OP_PAIN_DROPOFF.mitigation: Positive milestone reinforcement explaining why continuing reports until surgical discharge matters.

CONFUSING_OBSERVATION_INPUT.title: Subjective Wound Uncertainty
CONFUSING_OBSERVATION_INPUT.description: Patients felt hesitant choosing between 'improving' and 'concerning'.
CONFUSING_OBSERVATION_INPUT.mitigation: Clear visual reference guides and reassurance that all flagged observations go to their nurse.

NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILURE.title: Channel Delivery Dropouts
NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILURE.description: In-app notifications unread when app was closed for several consecutive days.
NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILURE.mitigation: Automated escalation to clinic staff for outreach follow-up upon 3 days of silence.
